//: Ported from CDDA. Its activity_level and proficiencies fields are dropped - CSE's recipe loader reads neither, and the proficiency system they lean on does not exist here.

CDDA builds this from the requirement groups tailoring_leather_small and fastener_small, neither of which CSE has; they expand to one leather, thread, and a small fastener. sewing_standard is CSE's equivalent for the thread and needle. CDDA's 3 hours assumes its proficiency penalties, so the time follows CSE's own leather storage recipes instead - backpack_leather is 50 minutes for twenty leather.

CDDA defines no disassembly for any wallet, so these two are CSE's own, and only for the wallets that can be built in the first place. Both return less than they cost, as CSE's other soft-goods uncrafts do.
